checks.message: SITE-001 is preserved as provisional_constraint with official_boundary=false and visible whole-package recalculation warnings.
All three key areas remain provisional; the public PROV-KEY-003 displacement warning is disclosed and no independent correction is claimed.
Six conceptual land-use polygons completely cover the provisional site without gaps or overlaps in EPSG:4548.
Buildings, green space and public space are contained by the provisional site in the spatial review.
Spatial values are recalculated from the submitted geometry; structured counts match local JSON assets; FAR, height and density remain unknown.
The exhibit is offline, contains all required visible sections and declares exact known metric values through data attributes.
Chinese and English proposals, five figure pairs, offline HTML, fourteen-page A3 booklets and four-board A0 sets are present and mapped in the manifest.
All required standards and design-depth items have claim-adjacent references; audit matrices provide exhaustive task coverage and keep unavailable controls unknown.
No site visit and no stakeholder interviews are explicitly disclosed; personas and user needs remain inferred pending field validation.
All three pilots include permission, baseline, test window, success, stop and accountable-human fields.

The proposal distinguishes former non-operating surface heritage, the operating high-speed railway in the Qinghuayuan Tunnel and returning to grade in the north, and operating Line 13 surface/embankment/viaduct segments; no crossing or subsurface feasibility is inferred.
